$comment: Provider pack: docling layout-aware document extraction (complex tables, multi-column, scanned PDFs where markitdown returns garbage). Deep-merged by deploy/merge-packs.mjs when the user passes --enable-pack docling. NOTE: docling-mcp[local] must be installed first (setup.sh does this via install_docling; ~3-4 GB with models from huggingface.co on first convert). Sets a root permissions rule {action: "docling*", effect: "allow"} so the rule-merge flips the source-config deny in place.
